assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and the three KEY_AREA polygons use provisional rough geometry derived from announcement text; official polygons are not yet published.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios and layer contents are design-model values recomputable from the submitted provisional geometry; they must be fully recalculated once official polygons arrive. This organiser-side gap does not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: green_ratio (32.99%) and public_space_ratio (4.22%) are recomputed from submitted green_space/public_space geometry over the provisional site boundary in EPSG:4548; the green layer includes ecological interfaces (Qinghe edge, Xiaoyuehe wedges) beyond pocket parks. The spine green (GREEN-001) and the Qinghe edge (GREEN-002) overlap by ~87,000 m2 at the north end; metrics use the union (de-duplicated) area, so per-feature area_sqm_declared values intentionally sum to slightly more than the reported green_space_area_sqm.
assumptions.impact: Ratios describe the design model, not statutory green-space control values; they are consistent with metrics.json and visual data-values and will be recalculated on official data.

assumptions.statement: floor_area_ratio, building height, building density and setback remain unknown because approved regulatory conditions are absent from the public site package.
assumptions.impact: No intensity claims are made; A3/A0 and HTML mark these as unknown with reasons, preventing fabricated precision.

assumptions.statement: Scenario nodes, landmarks, event systems and operation mechanisms are concept proposals positioned on provisional geometry; operator structures and event calendars are suggestions pending official decision.
assumptions.impact: No scenario, landmark or event is presented as an approved or confirmed arrangement.

assumptions.statement: Operational performance indicators (launch counts, visitors, contribution points, conversion rates) have no baseline data at submission time.
assumptions.impact: They are classified as third-category metrics to be calibrated after operations start; no numeric promises are made.

assumptions.statement: All figures (PNG), drawings (A3/A0 PDF) and the offline visual HTML are generated by the declared agent from the submitted GeoJSON using Pillow, reportlab and hand-written templates; system fonts (Hiragino Sans GB, STHeiti, Arial) render text into raster/vector output only.
assumptions.impact: No third-party images, logos, portraits or uncleared fonts are embedded as source assets; rendered text is baked into generated artifacts.
